description: Fetch a single Hugging Face paper by its arXiv id, e.g. 2608.05987 (from the /papers/2608.05987 URL or the url field in list-papers output). Returns title, abstract, authors, submitter, upvotes, comment count, publication date, and arXiv link. Reads HF's internal paper API plus the SSR comment section from the browser; no login required.

parameters.name: paper_id
parameters.description: Paper id (arXiv number), e.g. 2608.05987 from the URL https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.05987. Can be extracted from the url field in list-papers output (take the last path segment). 论文编号，取自 /papers/{id} URL 或 list-papers 的 url 字段提取。
